Nadia: The bakery should close its evening shift; sales after 5pm are barely a third of daytime.
Marco: The evening regulars keep us embedded in the street. Keep it open.
Nadia: If evening sales ever climb above half of daytime, I will gladly keep the shift.

extraction.mainQuestion: Should the bakery close its evening shift?

positions.label: Keep it open
